name: Raked Sand
description: A raked gravel garden whose grooves bend into rings around the stones standing in it; drag to rake new furrows.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Distance between grooves, in pixels. The rake has five tines at this spacing.

props.name: lineColor
props.description: Colour of the shaded side of each groove and of the shadows round the stones. Without it, blue ink by day and deep blue-black at night. Any CSS colour or token.

props.name: shade
props.description: Depth of the grooves and strength of the light across them, from 0 (barely raked) to 1.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and clips the garden. Other div props are passed through.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered above the gravel. Mark any element data-stone and the grooves ring it, following its border radius. Dragging on the gravel rakes furrows that stay in the pattern.
